I was looking for something that helped me relax my muscles as well as get a good, restful sleep. This felt more like a baseball bat than a gentle landing. The Beacon cheesequake was a much better fit and then the Heyday Night flower turned out to be the the lovely gentle product I was searching for. I gave the remains of my tub of sensi star to a friend who is a regular smoker and he really enjoyed it so I don't think it's a bad product it just wasn't right for me.

items.title: Mariposa: The Most Powerful and Consistent Strain I’ve Ever Used
items.body:
I have been using Mariposa for about five years, and after trying five or six other strains along th... 
                     I have been using Mariposa for about five years, and after trying five or six other strains along the way, nothing has ever come close to this one. Mariposa has consistently been the best strain for me year after year.

What I love most is its unique balance. It is deeply relaxing, grounding me into my body, while at the same time giving me energy, mental clarity, and a surge of creativity. It is rare to find a strain that can embody both deep calm and inspired focus, but Mariposa delivers this every single time.

Overall, it is an incredibly powerful strain, reliable, uplifting, and deeply supportive for both body and mind.

I took it via an oral syringe and followed a 0.05mL incrementing titration guide at 3-4 doses a day. I find 0.3mL provides some meaningful benefit in treating my conditions with low impairment.

During this starting phase I was getting a ' slight' buzz from it and was still very functional. It did help with my chronic back and neck pain and assisted with managing stiffness, tension headaches, dampening the 'stabbing pain', sciatica, inflammation, bowel movements (things are a lot smoother), insomnia and overall stress.
